title: Census small areas: LSOA 2021 (England & Wales), Data Zones 2022 (Scotland), Data Zones 2021 (Northern Ireland)
publisher: ONS, National Records of Scotland and NISRA
refresh: Only when the census geographies change (next after the 2031 census).
attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0; contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right. © Crown copyright, National Records of Scotland, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Contains NISRA data and Ordnance Survey of Northern Ireland information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
notes: Geography only — yields no statistics. Groups census Output Areas into ~47,000 LSOA-sized areas across the UK and gives each a population-weighted point. England & Wales: ONS LSOA 2021 population-weighted centroids. Northern Ireland: NISRA Data Zone 2021 population-weighted centroids (Irish Grid). Scotland: Data Zone 2022 points computed here as the population-weighted mean of NRS Output Area 2022 centroids — the method the Scottish Government documents for its own DZ centroids, whose service was not answering queries.
